parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing exposures are mixed. Positives: a statutory service anti-discrimination law covering gender identity, a constitutional ruling ending surgery conditions for legal gender change, and a supreme administrative court safeguard requiring vulnerability assessment before detaining trans foreigners. Negatives: detention practice below that safeguard is inconsistent; prison placement rules are unresolved; official hostility is documented at head-of-state and ministerial level; a 2023 LGBTQ+ survey (trans respondents highest, five-year window) shows large harassment rates; and hate-crime recording is acknowledged as incomplete. No trans-specific criminal offence or universal facility ban is documented. Relief is partial: a travel guide rates the two main cities as the most open, though it is not official data. No trans-specific violence rate is available. The rating sits at the elevated/reduced boundary, with unresolved custody placement and political hostility pulling it down.
